title: Finalist in the Philips Excellence Competition with the software capability team
summary: Our 13-person software capability core team, drawn from HR, the Software Center of Excellence, talent acquisition and software leadership, reached the finals of the Philips Excellence Competition with a program that mapped more than 6,000 employees to software job profiles and built a learning community. I presented in the finals.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a competition result, not an intervention.
what_i_did: Contributed from the Software Center of Excellence in the core team and presented in the finals.
what_changed: Finalist; a software capability leader congratulated us on the finals presentation.
